After 2 decades, Jamia Millia Islamia announces resumption of student union elections
articles.summary: Jamia Millia Islamia has ordered the holding of students' union elections within 15 days after constitutional approval. The university revoked disciplinary actions taken against students during recent protests and issued an inquiry into security conduct.

articles.title: BJP files police complaint against Kharge over 'baap' remark targeting PM Modi
articles.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party has lodged a police complaint against Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge in Patna. The complaint relates to Kharge's remarks about Prime Minister Modi during an event during 139th birth anniversary Bihar's first CM, Shrikrishna Singh.

articles.title: Trump Claims Trade Imbalance: accuses Canada of exploiting US; says deal likely but no rush
articles.summary: Donald Trump has voiced concerns that Canada has been exploiting trade advantages over the United States for years. He asserts that talks between the nations are nearing a satisfactory agreement for the U.S.

articles.title: ABBA’s Chiquitita raised over $5 million for UNICEF in 45 years; how the 1979 hit continues to protect children
articles.summary: ABBA's song Chiquitita has raised over US$5 million for UNICEF since its release in 1979. This funding supports various programs aimed at protecting vulnerable children from abuse and violence.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia’s Singapore plan: How Riyadh aims to protect Asian oil supplies from 2027
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia is set to store crude oil in Singapore starting in the second half of 2027. This arrangement aims to enhance energy security in the region amid supply disruptions.

articles.title: 'Utilizing Iran for politics': IDF chief, Netanyahu clash over military action ahead of Israel elections - report
articles.summary: Tension brews within Israel's leadership as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and IDF chief Eyal Zamir disagree on possible military action against Iran. This clash before elections raises eyebrows about political motives behind military strategies.

articles.title: Cyclone Arnab: Schools closed in Tamil Nadu districts, Puducherry and Karaikal on October 26, check complete details here
articles.summary: Schools in parts of Tamil Nadu and the Union Territory of Puducherry will remain closed on October 26 amid heavy rainfall and cyclone-related weather warnings. The closures aim to protect students and staff from waterlogging and travel disruptions.

articles.title: SRFTI students allege classroom power cut amid protest; institute denies targeting protesters
articles.summary: Students of the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute have alleged that electricity to a classroom used for internet access and workstation facilities was cut during their ongoing protest. The administration has denied targeting protesters and defended the rustication of six students.

articles.title: MP Police SI admit card 2026 released at esb.mp.gov.in: Check direct link to download hall tickets here
articles.summary: The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board has released the MP Police SI and Subedar Admit Card 2026 on October 24. Candidates appearing for the preliminary written examination, scheduled to begin on October 28, can download their hall tickets from esb.mp.gov.in.

articles.title: Delhi govt schools to get medical rooms with first-aid facilities, dedicated health worker
articles.summary: The Delhi government is planning to set up first-aid medical facilities in all government schools across the city. This initiative will ensure that trained health workers provide immediate care for students during school hours.

articles.title: Ahaana Krishna defends family amid Diya Krishna controversy
articles.summary: Ahaana Krishna spoke out on social media regarding the criticism her family received following Diya Krishna's recent post. She emphasized that each family member has their own opinions and should be judged individually.

articles.title: Harshith Reddy thanks Prabhas for supporting ‘Romeo Juliet’
articles.summary: Harshith Reddy expressed his heartfelt appreciation for the enthusiastic reception of the film's preview. He emphasized that his role in 'Romeo Juliet' offers something fresh for Telugu viewers.

articles.title: Nicki Minaj joins Donald Trump at Michigan rally
articles.summary: Nicki Minaj participated in a rally with Donald Trump in Michigan, encouraging voters to support Republican candidates. She expressed her admiration for Trump, claiming he represents resilience and a brighter future for children.

articles.title: Bhagyashri Borse dances with triplets Ghetto kids
articles.summary: Social media is abuzz after Bhagyashri Borse showcased a dance collaboration with the Triplets Ghetto Kids, revealing her admiration for their energetic performance. Posting on Instagram, she celebrated finishing the first schedule of her upcoming film, 'Operation Ganga', featuring celebrated actors Mohanlal and Arjun Rampal.
